KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

====

1. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maamkuzi na Maagano.

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.2 Aina za nomino Nomino za kawaida.

7. A — watoto

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

11. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.

12. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Udogo wa Nomino 2 Jumla ya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Sarufi 11.4.1 Ukanushaji Viambishi vya wakati li, na na ta; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
